msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia vivavision-12c.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of three sunglasses in black, tortoiseshell and grey acetate on a light wooden table from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia vivavision-11c.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Eyewear e-commerce photo of teal green cat-eye acetate sunglasses, no logos from the reference, front three-quarter view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless cool light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp acetate, metal and lens detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia vivavision-19c.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Eyewear e-commerce photo of red rectangular acetate eyeglasses, no logos from the reference, front three-quarter view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless cool light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp acetate, metal and lens detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): Eyewear e-commerce photo of lime green chunky acetate sunglasses with small pearl studs on the corners, no logos from the reference, front three-quarter view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless cool light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp acetate, metal and lens detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): Eyewear e-commerce photo of black double-bridge aviator eyeglasses in thin metal, no logos from the reference, front three-quarter view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless cool light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp acetate, metal and lens detail.
